ios.desc:
Plethora Studio is a platform for discovering, sharing, and experiencing interactive bits.

Bits are playable experiences: playful tools, visual experiments, mini games, animations, and creative ideas that people can open and explore inside the app.

With Plethora Studio, you can:

Discover interactive bits
Browse a feed of community-created bits, try them instantly, and save the ones you like.

Share bits with friends
Open shared links and jump into bits from the web or the app.

Join the community
Comment, reply, follow conversations, and explore creator profiles.

Stay in control
Report content, block users, delete your own content, and delete your account from Settings.

Plethora Studio is built for people who want the internet to feel less passive and more alive. Open an interactive bit, share it with someone, and join the conversation around it.

Bits are small interactive experiences: playful tools, visual experiments, mini games, animations, and creative ideas that people can publish and explore inside the app.

With Plethora Studio, you can:

interactive bits
